name: ecd-spectra
description: Precise, auditable extraction of experimental ECD spectra and measurement conditions from scientific literature.

interface.shortDescription: Recover ECD spectra and experimental conditions from literature.
interface.longDescription: An auditable workflow for extracting vector or raster ECD curves together with solvent composition, concentration, path length, temperature, provenance, signs, and units before comparison with computed spectra.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $extract-ecd-spectra to extract this published ECD spectrum into a validated numerical package.
